name: programme-series-diagnostic-kernel
purpose: Compute a deterministic diagnostic-only appraisal from an ordered programme series without granting promotion authority.
rationale: The mechanism is a pure stateless function over explicit records and has no scheduling, persistence, recovery, or external effects.
Moving the implementation to quant removes an upward dependency while a programme-layer facade preserves the stable public API.

boundary.owns: Programme-series record validation, diagnostic trend aggregation, and path-to-record projection
boundary.mechanism: Map explicit ordered records or path nodes to a diagnostic appraisal with promotion_authority false
non_goals: Scheduling, retries, persistence, or external effects
Changing the historical lakatos.programme.series public import path
boundary.state_authority: The caller owns all inputs; this module owns no mutable state

invariants: Identical records and window produce an identical appraisal.
The result never has promotion authority.
The programme facade and quant kernel expose the same public objects and preserve historical pickle identity.
failure_model: Malformed records or window values raise typed ValueError before any mutation.
verification: Programme-series unit and sea-of-anomalies tests cover trends and invalid inputs.
A facade identity and pickle roundtrip test protects compatibility.
Import-linter proves the programme to verdict to quant to io layering without exceptions.
promotion_gates: Durable programme-series state, concurrent writers, scheduling, recovery, or replaceable adapters become part of the contract.
A stable command or event protocol is required by multiple operational consumers.
falsifiers: If a consumer requires stateful coordination rather than pure appraisal, reassess the boundary.
If compatibility requires quant to import programme, this placement is invalid.
